CRP.notes: No spray-dried dairy cream powder found at reachable Hong Kong retailers. WebSearch budget exhausted (session-wide 200/200); several HK retailers are behind bot walls, so this BRAK is partly inconclusive. Re-checked 2026-09-17 under the new owner rule (a real spray-dried dairy cream powder outside 38-48 % fat is a valid B_SAME_TYPE_DIFFERENT_COMPOSITION candidate). Still BRAK: no dairy cream powder of any fat level was found on a page that binds to this market. The only genuine retail dairy cream powder found anywhere in this pass is Hoosier Hill Farm "Heavy Cream Powder" (hoosierhillfarm.com, "made with 100% real sweet cream", "72% butterfat content", 1 lb / 2 lb / 25 lb, US) - it is NOT recorded as a candidate because the seller's shipping policy (hoosierhillfarm.com/policies/shipping-policy) prints no destination countries and no international-delivery statement, so there is no verifiable purchase path into this market. Owner may want to ask them directly. BRAK stands. The whole BakingWarehouse catalogue (1 500 rows) was re-read: lactose-free, skimmed and whole milk powders and Candia UHT whipping cream only. foodcraft.hk answered HTTP 429 and was not bypassed. Owner rule 3 (B2B stays B2B): the only genuine dairy cream powder route that exists in this region is industrial - Fonterra/NZMP "Cream Powder 55" (blend of fresh dairy cream and skim milk, spray-dried, 55 % fat, quote verified) and regional B2B dairy traders such as bestdairies.com (Klang, Malaysia) in 25 kg sacks. Tagged B2B, not presented as a retail offer and not recorded as a candidate because no purchase page binds it to this market. Retail shelves in the region carry non-dairy creamers, whole/full-cream milk powders and whipped-topping mixes, which the protocol rejects. 2026-09-17 close-asia round: the search was widened from local shops to the cross-border sellers whose delivery statements do name this market. gourmet-versand.com - the one seller whose shipping-cost country selector names this country - has a category literally called "Cream powder and masses" but it holds only cooking-cream and dessert mixes plus plain milk powders; taste-market.de and pati-versand.de deliver inside Europe only; msk-ingredients.com offers only a bare "worldwide" claim. No dairy cream powder at any fat level could be tied to this market, so CRP stays BRAK.
